title: Mermaid Roshan and the Song Beneath the Pool

characters.Hana: Tall copper-haired choreographer; half-up twisted crown, celadon shell clip, coral long-sleeved jacket, cream high-neck blouse, celadon tail/deep-teal fan fin.
characters.Nari: Younger shorter singer; navy chin-length bob/curled ends, silver crescent clip, mint hooded jacket, peach scarf/collar, lavender tail/peach fin.
characters.Duri: Lavender turtle with mint floral shell; courier trapped by soft concert props.

spreads.name: pool_invitation
spreads.left:
The castle's candle was still missing.
But Rumi's pool shimmered, and its rainbow kept turning.
spreads.right:
"Come and sing with my friends," said Rumi.
"My voice is very little," said Roshan.
Rumi held out her hand.
spreads.scene: Familiar Pearl Castle pool room. Roshan and Rumi at the near turquoise pool rim, Rumi offers one hand, Roshan shy but curious, rainbow waterfall left, seahorse fountain right, lavender arches, shell throne, towel shelf. No other characters. One calm invitation.

spreads.name: city_beneath_pool
spreads.left:
Down they swam, beneath the shining water.
They were still inside Pearl Castle.
A whole city glowed below.
spreads.right:
Curved roofs. Bright shops. A bubble tram!
Roshan's tail flashed rainbow colours.
"All this was under our pool?"
spreads.scene: Big cinematic underwater city discovery. Roshan and Rumi swimming downward from familiar illuminated oval pool underside, lavender castle columns above, Korean curved-tile-roof houses, warm projecting pictogram shop signs, lavender apartment blocks, pearl transit bridge and bubble tram, far shell stage. No surface ocean or dry city; all figures float in clear underwater volume. Wide magical geography, characters large foreground left/right away from central gutter.

spreads.name: meet_hana_nari
spreads.left:
Hana waved from the music room.
Her copper hair floated like a ribbon.
Nari peeped around her shoulder.
spreads.right:
"I'm good at big dance moves," said Hana.
"I'm good at hearing tiny things," said Nari.
"I'm good at being here," said Roshan.
spreads.scene: Welcoming encounter at an underwater neighbourhood music-room doorway under a curved Korean tiled eave, warm round window and music pictogram, cream stone/celadon timber. Tall copper-haired Hana gestures openly; petite navy-bob Nari peeks from beside her; Rumi and child Roshan arrive. Four characters distinct no doubles, friendly expressive faces. Original new identity designs from cast reference.

spreads.name: first_song_no_answer
spreads.left:
Rumi, Hana and Nari began.
"Little voice, big blue sea.
Sing with you, sing with me."
spreads.right:
Usually, the city sang back.
Tonight, no answer came.
Between the notes, Roshan heard:
Tap. Tap. Tap.
spreads.scene: Manga-inspired page-spread with three clean rounded panels reading left to right. Large panel: Rumi Hana Nari singing into pearl microphones in cozy lavender seating lounge with shell speakers, Roshan shyly joins. Second smaller panel: quiet city bridge with still streamers and no answering neighbours. Final clear close-up: Roshan tilts head/listens, palm at ear, tiny bubbles near window. No text or music symbols shaped as readable letters, no sound captions, no photoreal 3D.

spreads.name: hear_turtle
spreads.left:
"Wait," whispered Roshan.
"Someone is asking for help."
She followed the tapping beneath the tram bridge.
spreads.right:
A little turtle was caught between two prop crates.
A soft concert banner tangled round his shell.
"I'm Duri," he said. "I'm stuck."
spreads.scene: Two-panel comic spread. Left supporting panel: Roshan leads Rumi Hana Nari down the clearly navigable current below pearl tram bridge, pointing at soft sound/bubbles. Dominant right panel: gentle worried lavender turtle Duri/mint floral shell safe in a gap BETWEEN two concert prop crates, soft fabric banner tangled at shell edge, no crushing/injury; Roshan and Rumi crouch/float beside him looking carefully. Turtle brightly visible, warm underbridge service alcove, quiet kelp. No shipwreck or blanket/dustbunnies.

spreads.name: rescue_duri
spreads.left:
"We'll make you a space," said Roshan.
Rumi held the banner loose.
Roshan pushed one crate away.
spreads.right:
Hana steadied the other crate.
Nari counted, "One, two, gently!"
Duri wriggled free.
"You heard me!"
spreads.scene: Three sequential rounded comic panels with physically clear staged rescue, safe no force on turtle. 1 Roshan bracing palms on LEFT movable crate, Rumi unloops soft banner away from turtle shell. 2 Hana steadies other separate crate, Nari supports/encourages; open gap and lifted loose fabric visible. 3 relieved Duri freely swims toward Roshan and Rumi; all single-tail mermaids. Continuity same service alcove, two crates now visibly separated. Clear correct hand/object contact.

spreads.name: bathhouse_rest_song
spreads.left:
They rested in the warm-current bathhouse.
Duri stopped trembling.
Roshan sang him a very little song.
spreads.right:
"Make a space and let it through.
There's a place for me and you."
Nari hummed beside her.
Duri smiled.
spreads.scene: Quiet cozy recovery in underwater Korean neighbourhood bathhouse, celadon/mint mosaic warming-current seating basin, round pearl benches, seahorse water fixture, rising fine bubbles not steam. Roshan and shorter Nari sing gently to Duri close and visible; Rumi/Hana relaxed behind them. All mermaids keep their original modest jackets/blouses and one tail, no bathing undress, no hot dangerous water. Large soft calm picture, warm cream light.

spreads.name: imp_clue
spreads.left:
Then a top hat bobbed past.
A purple imp popped out of the bubbles.
"The stage is ours tonight!" he squeaked.
spreads.right:
Another imp dragged a glittery prop crate.
Duri pointed after them.
"They piled those in our current channel."
spreads.scene: Playful underwater bathhouse-door interruption. Existing navy fully clothed magician imp with red bowtie/top hat comically pops amid small bubbles, existing purple glitter-jacket performer imp hauling a light stage prop crate beyond doorway. Four mermaids and Duri face them with surprised determination not fear. Through doorway clear route toward shell-stage district, pearl/kelp scenery. Imps have trousers/shoes, no bare torso, no weapons aimed at children. Two linked panels, no text.

spreads.name: current_gate_plan
spreads.left:
Duri led them through a quiet passage.
At the concert terrace, ribbons barely stirred.
Crates were jammed against the current gate.
spreads.right:
"The song can't reach our neighbours," said Rumi.
Hana raised her chin. Nari listened.
Roshan looked at the gap beneath the crates.
spreads.scene: Single clear investigation image from under elevated shell concert terrace. Large gold-rimmed circular current arch/gate fixed in stone, partly blocked by three piled separate prop crates and limp soft banners. No chains/trappedcreatures. Roshan foreground points to low safe opening; Duri guides at her shoulder; Rumi Hana Nari examine independently. Faint existing blue glow visible through obstruction, proving magic remains. Above terrace, imps' shell speakers/stage; Korean shops and hanging tiles secondary. Readable objective geometry not gloomy dungeon.

spreads.name: concert_fight_start
spreads.left:
They swam up to the shell stage.
"Move your props, please," said Roshan.
The imps stuck out their tongues.
spreads.right:
Rumi took the first note.
Hana swept into a bright dance.
Nari beat the rhythm.
Roshan swam straight towards the gate.
spreads.scene: Two bold child-readable comic panels. Left smaller: Roshan politely confronts TWO existing fully costumed purple imps on lavender shell stage, other friends behind. Right larger: Rumi singing with microphone, Hana choreographed sweeping arm pose, Nari rhythm taps small shell drum, Roshan swimming decisively along stage edge toward gatebelow; imps winding up soft round foam stars. No swords/filmweapons or copiedfilmposes/logos, no sexualcostume; warm pink/orchid stage lights against cyan underwater city. Action begins with purposeful movement.

spreads.name: bubble_battle
spreads.left:
POOF! A cloud of bubbles!
WHOOSH! A flying foam star!
Hana caught it on a soft banner.
spreads.right:
Nari ducked. Rumi spun.
Roshan swept a ribbon around the wobbling crate.
The imps bounced backwards onto cushions.
spreads.scene: Three compact clean manga panels of real playful physical fight with existing costumed imps: 1 magician sends little bubble puff; 2 Hana catches large SOFT FOAM STAR in a slack fabric banner hammock, Nari ducks safely besideher, Rumi turns clear; 3 performer imp comically bounces backward onto obvious padded stage cushions after Roshan deftly loops fabric ribbon round blocking propcrate, no binding person. No wounds, frightening teeth, explosions, lightning, sharpblades or weapons; single tails not multiplelimbs; clear motion/contact and amused determined faces. Restrained swoosh arcs no unreadable captions.

spreads.name: roshan_opens_gate
spreads.left:
"Now," said Roshan.
Rumi held the ribbon with her.
Hana pushed. Nari pulled.
Together, they moved the last crate.
spreads.right:
Duri slipped through the open arch.
The current rushed after him.
Blue light curled round the stage.
The magic had been there all along.
spreads.scene: Dominant heroic physically clear teamwork repair, not spellcast. Roshan and Rumi side by side pulling same loose ribbon attached to a light crate on low ledge; Hana's two palms push its opposite exposed side, Nari tugs separate fabric handle. LAST crate moves sideways away from gold circular currentarch which is visibly open now; lavender floral-shell Duri swims unharmed through centre. Flow ribbons/bright cyan current curve through opened channel. In small inset two clothed imps sit on padded cushions surprised. All mermaid tails one continuous body, faces visible; no obstruction duplicated behind moved crate.

spreads.name: city_encore
spreads.left:
The shops answered first.
Then the bathhouse. Then the tram.
Little voices travelled through the bright blue city.
spreads.right:
Roshan sang with Rumi, Hana and Nari.
She did not sing the loudest.
But this time, she heard everyone.
spreads.scene: Expansive celebratory evening-underwater encore. Main quartet Roshan Rumi Hana Nari at established shell concert stage together singing; Duri beside them. Korean tiled-roof neighbourhood, projecting shops, pearl bridge/bubble tram visible in rear; diverse small mermaid neighbours sing from balconies and tramwindows, warm lights connected by flowing cyan current rather than new mysticalbarrier. Open gate visible belowstage, no crates blocking. Faces/foursilhouettes readable. Two repentant costumedimps unobtrusive atside. Big musical payoff pinklavendergold controlled palette no abstractneonstorm.

spreads.name: imps_make_space
spreads.left:
The imps peeked over their cushions.
"Is there a place for us?"
"Yes," said Roshan. "If you make space for others."
spreads.right:
They carried the crates away.
One played a tiny bell. One took a bow.
Even Duri joined in:
Tap. Tap. Tap.
spreads.scene: Warm comic resolution on same cleared shellstage. Main view: glitter-jacket imp responsibly carries small propcrate to tidy side storageshelf, magician imp in full suit rings a small pearlbellextended arm/top hat tipped bow; Roshan smiles and directs with open palm, Rumi Hana Nari welcoming. Duri taps small drumwithflipper (not unnaturalhumanhand). Visible open currentarch below, emptycentre. Softcomic smallinset impbow ifneeded, no new violentbanishing/humiliation, no giant cheeringcrowd. Stage costumes unchanged.

spreads.name: home_pool
spreads.left:
At last, Rumi and Roshan swam home.
Above them, the familiar rainbow turned.
The seahorse fountain splashed its welcome.
spreads.right:
"We haven't found the candle yet," said Roshan.
"No," said Rumi. "But today you heard a friend."
And somewhere below, a little turtle tapped goodnight.
spreads.scene: Final peaceful return to original PearlCastle poolroom identity, rainbow waterfallleft, seahorse fountainright, lavenderarches/shellthrone/towels, turquoiseforegroundpool. Roshan and Rumi rest at near poolrim smiling quietly together, their one mermaidtailssubmergedvisible. Underwater far below a subtle tiny Duri turtle silhouette swims home, not inside dryroom. Warm restful lighting, no thirdperson/candleappearance. Composition echoes firstspread toclosecircle, simple calm no panels.
